Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase at 23:59:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 is strictly greater than $80,000.
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase at 23:59:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 is less than or equal to $80,000.

Clarifications:
- "Close August 2026" is interpreted as the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase at 23:59:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 (the end of the last calendar day of the month in UTC).
